raw_response:
I farm only 7 mu, and my family has off-farm work, so I will keep the plan practical and not too labor-intensive. Since I already follow a wheat-maize system and I have well irrigation, I will keep most of my land in that rotation because it is the steadiest way for me to secure grain and spread risk across two seasons. I will put 4 mu into winter wheat and then summer maize on the same 4 mu. I will keep 2 mu in cotton because cotton still gives me cash income, but I will not expand it because it needs more management and picking labor. I will plant 1 mu of watermelon for cash and household use, but I will keep the area small because it is more sensitive and takes close care. I will use improved or hybrid seed where it helps yield and stability, use moderate fertilizer because I have irrigation and want dependable production, and I will avoid overly heavy input because at my age and with limited family labor at home, I want a plan I can carry through steadily.
